applications.description:
Phase 2a (Full planning permission) to include the construction
of new dwellings to provide residential homes (Use Class C3), along with cycle
and vehicle parking, highway and access improvements, children’s play space,
public realm enhancements and associated landscaping ("the
Development").The proposal provides 2no. new buildings (Block A & Block
B) at 3-4 storeys in height. Building A is proposed at three storeys and
Building B is proposed at four storeys. 45no. units (Use class C3) (18no x
1b2p, 18no x 2b4p, 7no x 3b5p, 2no x3b6p), including the provision of 5no. part
M4(3) homes for wheelchair users. 100% affordable homes comprising, 36no. units
(80% provided for social rent) and 9no. units (20% provided as London Living
Rent).32no. car parking spaces provided including 5no.
accessible disabled parking bays.  A total of 92no. long-stay and 4no.
short-stay cycle parking spaces will be provided in dedicated cycle stores.Block A would incorporate x3 1,100litre bin for general
waste, x3 1,100litre bin for recycling and x2 240litre bin for food waste.Block B would incorporate x4 1,100litre bin for general waste,
x4 1,100litre bin for recycling and x3 240litre bin for food waste.30no. new trees are to be planted on site.The amount of hard landscape on the Site is 2,823sqm and there
is 2,804sqm of hard landscape proposed in total. The amount of existing soft
landscaping in the scheme is 2,368sqm with 2,191sqm proposed.













683sqm of publicly accessible open space is proposed.
145sqm of playable space is provided at ground floor level (77sqm for
5–11-year-olds and 68sqm for 0–4year-olds.)

game.plainImpact: 45 homes, 100% affordable vs London Plan 35%. This is a major under the usual 35%. Northwick Park Hospital is a hike. Street-crime count in May 2026 is high (491 within 400 m, locations approximate). This borough's 2023–24 affordable pace was 349.
